extraction.notes: 2027 dates and prices were found in the official 2027 Dates & Rates PDF through search indexing; direct opens returned no readable content. Registration is announced for November 2026, with the exact date still pending. Program details not updated for 2027 are taken from current program pages or the 2026 brochure. Leap and MS TKO Starter appear in older materials or navigation but are absent from the 2027 schedule and are not included. Middle- and high-school versions of Cascade, Survivor and Water Adventure are grouped as age-band rows. Mini Camp weeks are shown as the PDF lists them, not split into unconfirmed half-week sessions.
